categories.main_business_segments: Gree Electric Appliances operates primarily in two segments: consumer appliances and industrial equipment. Consumer products include household air conditioners, HVAC systems, refrigerators, washing machines, water heaters, kitchen appliances, environmental appliances, smart buildings, and smart home systems. Industrial products cover high-end equipment, precision molds, refrigeration and freezing equipment, motors, compressors, capacitors, semiconductor devices, precision casting, basic materials, industrial energy storage, and recycling resources.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes core technology self-development with a strong R&D system including national-level research centers and numerous patents. Key technologies include AI-driven energy-saving air conditioning, advanced compressor and motor designs, magnetic levitation motor systems, and integrated smart home IoT platforms. Manufacturing integrates intelligent automation, robotics, 5G, AI, and digital factory systems to ensure high-quality, efficient production and flexible capacity layout.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gree serves a broad customer base including individual consumers, commercial enterprises, industrial users, and public infrastructure projects. Its products are used in residential, commercial, industrial, and public sectors such as hotels, hospitals, transportation hubs, and industrial parks. The company also targets global markets with tailored products for different climate zones and regional preferences.
categories.geographic_coverage: Gree operates extensively in China with production bases in Guangdong, Chongqing, Anhui, and other provinces, as well as overseas facilities in Brazil. Its products are sold in over 190 countries and regions worldwide, with significant market presence in Europe, North America, Latin America, Africa, and Asia. The company maintains a comprehensive sales and service network domestically and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gree operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, encompassing product design, core component manufacturing (compressors, motors, capacitors, semiconductors), assembly, sales, and after-sales services. It controls key upstream components through subsidiaries and strategic partnerships, ensuring high self-sufficiency and competitive advantage.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in energy efficiency, environmental sustainability, smart home integration, and industrial automation. R&D focuses on AI-driven dynamic energy-saving technologies, advanced compressor and motor systems, smart HVAC solutions, and semiconductor integration. Gree also invests in digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and green recycling technologies to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Gree generates revenue mainly through product sales of consumer appliances and industrial equipment. It also earns income from after-sales services, licensing of technologies, and financial investments. The company leverages both offline retail networks and online platforms to maximize sales channels and customer reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gree is a leading player in the Chinese and global home appliance market, especially in air conditioning where it holds the top domestic market share and ranks first globally in split air conditioner retail volume. It competes with other major domestic and international appliance manufacturers, maintaining a strong brand reputation through quality, innovation, and service excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Gree reported total revenue of approximately RMB 190 billion, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 32.18 billion, reflecting a 10.91% year-on-year profit growth despite a slight revenue decline. The company has a total asset base exceeding RMB 368 billion and net assets of RMB 137 billion, demonstrating robust financial scale and steady profitability growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gree emphasizes superior product quality, advanced core technologies, and comprehensive smart home solutions to deliver energy-efficient, comfortable, and healthy living environments. Its PQAM perfect quality assurance model and long-term warranty policies differentiate it in the market. The company’s commitment to innovation, sustainability, and customer-centric design underpins its brand promise of 'making the world love Chinese manufacturing.'
